title: AutoApply socket protocol
description: NDJSON over <home>/autoapplyd.sock. GENERATED by `uv run python -m autoapply.models` from engine/autoapply/models.py - do not edit by hand. See contract/protocol.md.

AckPayload.description: Success reply to a command (envelope carries ``reply_to``).
AckPayload.title: AckPayload

file_path.description: Absolute path to the PDF; the daemon copies it into <home>/resumes/.
file_path.title: File Path

action.description: Short verb phrase, e.g. 'answering "Years with Go"'.
action.title: Action

save_to_profile.description: Never-guess clusters: write to never_guess instead.
save_to_profile.title: Save To Profile

AppState.description: Agent state machine for an application (contract/protocol.md §State machine).
AppState.title: AppState

ApplicationStatusPayload.description: Manual board status changed (user drag-drop, auto-ghost, notification action).
ApplicationStatusPayload.title: ApplicationStatusPayload

ApplyAnywayPayload.description: User override of a hard-filter / below-threshold skip: skipped -> queued (actor user).
ApplyAnywayPayload.title: ApplyAnywayPayload

BoardStatus.description: Manual post-apply board status (only once state == submitted).
BoardStatus.title: BoardStatus

Counts.description: Live counters for badges / hero. Derived from the DB at snapshot time.

suggestions_pending.description: Company suggestions waiting for Add / Dismiss (Settings > Sources badge).
suggestions_pending.title: Suggestions Pending

Counts.title: Counts

ErrorPayload.description: Failure reply to a command (with ``reply_to``) or an unsolicited daemon error.
ErrorPayload.title: ErrorPayload

FormQuestion.description: A question harvested from an application form (ATS API or browser scan).

key.description: Stable field id/name within the form.
key.title: Key

label.description: Question text as shown to the applicant.
label.title: Label

FormQuestion.title: FormQuestion

test.description: Also log in now to check the stored password still works.
test.title: Test

NeverGuess.description:
Facts the agent never guesses. ``None`` means "always ask me".

Each field is one row in the ``never_guess`` table (key = field name, value = JSON).

work_auth.description: Country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 or name) -> status, e.g. {'US': 'requires_sponsorship', 'IN': 'citizen'}.
work_auth.title: Work Auth

NeverGuess.title: NeverGuess

work_auth.description: Country (ISO-3166 alpha-2 or name) -> status, e.g. {'US': 'requires_sponsorship', 'IN': 'citizen'}.
work_auth.title: Work Auth

Preferences.description: Job-search preferences. Field names == ``preferences`` table columns.

work_auth_summary.description: Free text, e.g. 'India citizen; needs US sponsorship'.
work_auth_summary.title: Work Auth Summary

per_ats_mode.description: Per-ATS mode override. Missing ATS = inherit global mode.
per_ats_mode.title: Per Ats Mode

searches_per_session.description: Search result pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
searches_per_session.title: Searches Per Session

jobs_per_session.description: Job detail pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
jobs_per_session.title: Jobs Per Session

always_ask_patterns.description: Regexes; matching form questions always go to the inbox.
always_ask_patterns.title: Always Ask Patterns

Preferences.title: Preferences

work_auth_summary.description: Free text, e.g. 'India citizen; needs US sponsorship'.
work_auth_summary.title: Work Auth Summary

per_ats_mode.description: Per-ATS mode override. Missing ATS = inherit global mode.
per_ats_mode.title: Per Ats Mode

searches_per_session.description: Search result pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
searches_per_session.title: Searches Per Session

jobs_per_session.description: Job detail pages read per LinkedIn/Glassdoor session.
jobs_per_session.title: Jobs Per Session

always_ask_patterns.description: Regexes; matching form questions always go to the inbox.
always_ask_patterns.title: Always Ask Patterns

ProfilePatch.description: All-optional Profile for ``update_profile``; only keys present are applied.
ProfilePatch.title: ProfilePatch

QuestionCluster.description: A Needs-You inbox cluster: semantically equivalent questions answered once.

options.description: Union of options across the cluster.
options.title: Options

suggested_answer.description: The agent's low-confidence draft, to accept or edit.
suggested_answer.title: Suggested Answer

suggested_note.description: What the draft could not cover from the user's facts (shown beside it, never inside it).
suggested_note.title: Suggested Note

QuestionCluster.title: QuestionCluster

QuestionReason.description: Why a question was parked in the Needs-You inbox.
QuestionReason.title: QuestionReason

submitted.description: User verified whether the submission went through.
submitted.title: Submitted

SetApplicationResumePayload.description:
Swap the resume an application will use (Review ↻). An application awaiting review is
sent back to ``queued`` so the form is re-filled with the new file.
SetApplicationResumePayload.title: SetApplicationResumePayload

email.description: Mailbox the ATSs send security codes to (usually your application email).
email.title: Email

app_password.description: App password (Gmail: myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Stored in the macOS Keychain only.
app_password.title: App Password

SnapshotPayload.description: Full live state. Sent as the reply to ``hello`` (and on demand).
SnapshotPayload.title: SnapshotPayload

SourceName.description: Discovery sources whose connection status the UI shows.
SourceName.title: SourceName

message.description: Human sentence for the hero / menu bar.
message.title: Message

SuggestedPreferences.description: Job-search preferences suggested from the resume; the app pre-fills, the user saves.

years_experience.description: From the profile, else estimated from work history.
years_experience.title: Years Experience

SuggestedPreferences.title: SuggestedPreferences

notes.description: Free-form user notes; null or empty clears them.
notes.title: Notes
